decision: Orb added Hazard, Primed and Respect; the EP cut Brink (the crown's brink ring covers it), kept Resolve (sequenced after the crown's wear pop) and kept Pride apart from Triumph. Then Orb removed hiding from the base game (held for a future stealth fighter), so Primed (the ambush window) moves to held with Winded, Smug and Bored. Thirteen active flashes, four of them info (danger, hazard, found, searching). Found and Searching stay, for lock-on regained and lost through line of sight.

primed.name: Primed
primed.note: Held: the ambush window needs hiding, which the base game no longer has. Points forward and up, a single direction.

arbitration.note: A flash due while the crown is up waits up to default_wait_max and is then dropped, except a flash with a sequence block: Resolve starts delay_after_crown_down seconds after the crown goes down (crown_up() false), waits up to wait_max, and is never dropped by arbitration (only the surge can preempt it).

note: Canonical data, written by art/concepts/marked-aura/gen.mjs (Art owns data/art/). Angles are degrees (0 forward, 90 up), d and s are in units of head size / 12. Names and looks are placeholders.

emotion_colours.rule: Emotion flashes: rim is the accent mid step and core the accent light step, except where the accent sits on the fighter's own hair. The Protagonist's teal flashes overlap his teal hair, so his rim is the accent light step and his core is near-white. The rim must be lighter than the hair mid step by at least 15 L*.

low_crest.note: Wide and low behind the head: angle a becomes atan2(sin(a) * 0.4, cos(a)) + 42 degrees, size x 0.7, distance + 4, Ground shards are unchanged. So the transformed angle lands within 65 to 175, every flash in the crest set keeps its input angles between 65 and 110 degrees (checked by gen.mjs, which fails if a drawn angle leaves 65 to 175).

danger_ray.note: Rotate the whole pointer train to the threat bearing at run time (facing frame, 0 forward, 90 up). Always above or behind the head, never around it.

legal_rules.info_keyline: The core fills 84 percent of the rim. Emotion flashes keep a rim and a 58 percent core.

keep_out.rule: Every shape sits up and back of the head: angle a between 65 and 175 degrees in the facing frame (0 forward, 90 up, 180 back), never forward toward the opponent and never below the head centre. Nothing covers a torso or a face, on either fighter. The largest shape is 40 (the surge crest) and most are 30 or less, in hundredths of a body height.
keep_out.ground_shards: The surge has two small shards at the fighter's own feet (195 and 345 degrees, distance 22, size 10).

pulse_rule.note: Each flash pulses two or three times, then is gone. A pulse swells to full in 30 percent of `on`, then shrinks to nothing by the end of `on` (a beat of nothing for `off` follows). The last pulse holds to the end of `on`, then fades over `fade`. Size scales 0.55 + 0.45 k and opacity k, as before. total = count x on + (count - 1) x off + fade, 0.4 to 0.8 s, and the surge 1.85 s.

danger.name: Danger sense
danger.moment: A telegraphed heavy or beam, or an attack from off screen or behind. A parry window keeps the crown's ring, because a flash would double it.
danger.sound: A low dry tick with a short upward sweep. No chirp, no stinger.

hazard.name: Hazard
hazard.moment: The world is about to hit the fighter: a falling building, a collapsing crater rim, a beam path, rising water. Not a fighter attack (that is danger sense).

found.name: Found
found.moment: A lost lock-on is regained: the rival is back in line of sight.
found.sound: One bright rising note, in the fighter's own pitch.

searching.name: Searching
searching.moment: Lock-on lost: the rival has dropped out of line of sight and the fighter looks for it. It re-pops at most every 3 s while the search lasts.

fear.name: Fear
fear.moment: An opponent starts a finisher, or the fighter watches a rival transform.
fear.event: finisher_start against the fighter, cinematic_start of the rival
fear.sound: A shiver: a quick tremolo on a held breath.

rage.name: Rage
rage.moment: Drop the Act, a wrath spike, a boil-over, a humiliating parry.
rage.sound: A growl that swells and cuts off.

hurt.name: Hurt
hurt.moment: A heavy hit or a break launch, when the crown is not up. A flurry gives one flash: a six-second cooldown per fighter keeps it from being busy (AI play fired it about 9 times a minute).

resolve.name: Resolve
resolve.moment: A Rally or Second Wind: the fighter gathers itself. It fires just after the crown's wear pop fades, and it is never dropped by arbitration.
resolve.sound: A breath in, then a low held note.

triumph.name: Triumph
triumph.moment: A finisher lands, or a KO for the winner.
triumph.sound: A bright chime with the fighter's laugh.

pride.name: Pride
pride.moment: After a decisive exchange won, before the next one. The Anti-hero's front.
pride.sound: A slow exhale and a held soft chord.

respect.name: Respect
respect.moment: A clash ends in a draw, a finisher is blocked, or a rival gets back up after a heavy hit: the fighter acknowledges the other.
respect.event: clash_draw, finisher_blocked, rally of the rival

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.sound: The fighter's sneer or dry laugh.

surge.name: Surge
surge.moment: A transformation: three slow pulses of a small crest above and behind the head at the start of the cinematic (1.85 s in all), then gone. Never a standing cloud, never over the body.
surge.sound: A rising swell that resolves on the new form's chord.
